title: 扫地机拖布收纳盒 抹布收纳盒
titleTranslated: Sweeper Mop Storage Box Rag Storage Box
summary: 通用扫地机拖布的收纳盒，因为有好多拖布，可以集中一次清洗，分为2层，上层放置使用过的拖布，下层放置干净的拖布，节省空间，收纳整齐。
summaryTranslated: A storage box for universal sweeper mops. Since there are many mops, they can be cleaned all at once. It is divided into 2 layers: the upper layer holds used mops, and the lower layer holds clean mops, saving space and keeping them neatly organized.

instances.title: 0.2mm 层高, 3 层墙, 无需支撑
instances.summary: 0.2mm 层高, 3 层墙, 15% 填充，无需支撑。
